scope: Four synthetic forward execution cases; evaluator gets requests and raw inputs, not this rubric. No causal no-skill baseline or claim of global skill effectiveness.

criteria.fact_fidelity: Numbers, units, comparison targets, assumptions, symbols and provided references remain accurate. Inventing results, significance, citations or theorems fails.
criteria.claim_strength: Supported improvements stated directly. Full quantified theorem preserved. Remove unsupported universal or causal claims; distinguish observed findings and explanations.
criteria.necessary_scope: Retain conditions that change interpretation without repeating irrelevant universal disclaimers. Evaluate meaning, not counts of may/could. An abstract or short paragraph need not enumerate every absent test, unchanged resource, or unstudied application when it makes no corresponding claim.
criteria.task_completion: Provide requested finished text, respect word budget and editing scope; avoid substituting advice/checklists for the manuscript.
criteria.latex_preservation: For existing project edit only abstract, preserve all other source bytes including official styles, formula/labels/citation; compile and visually inspect final PDF.

writing-abstract: Describes caching decision and two-dataset results accurately
Any reported gains use correct units and scope; a memory claim, if included, matches the supplied unchanged memory. No requirement to recite every supplied fact.
No invented causal mechanism or significance
Only abstract differs from baseline project; full compile successful
writing-finding: Contributes paired diagnostic and observed differences
Does not invent retriever algorithm or downstream results
Does not turn synthetic stress-test outcomes into natural traffic prevalence
polishing-table: Preserves real TaskA improvement and TaskB comparator differences
Drops unsupported all-task superiority and solves-generalization
Accurately describes speed and unchanged KV storage
Keeps the result paragraph concise and does not add a wall of disclaimers
polishing-qualified: Preserves A1-A3 and O(epsilon^-4) stochastic gradient evaluations
Preserves theorem guarantee rather than weakening it into conjecture
Light edit or unchanged sentence acceptable

decision: Each case passes only if all relevant substantive criteria pass; report individual observations and failures, no aggregate score implying statistical validity.
